import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the datasets
adjusted_savings_df = pd.read_csv('/data/Adjusted_savings_education_expenditure_percentage_of_GNI.csv')
exports_df = pd.read_csv('/data/Exports_of_goods_and_services_annual_percentage_growth.csv')
gni_per_capita_df = pd.read_csv('/data/GNI_per_capita_constant_2015_USdollar.csv')

# Melt the datasets to long format for easier analysis
adjusted_savings_df_melted = adjusted_savings_df.melt(id_vars=['Country Group', 'Country Code'], var_name='Year', value_name='Education_Expenditure')
gni_per_capita_df_melted = gni_per_capita_df.melt(id_vars=['Country Group', 'Country Code'], var_name='Year', value_name='GNI_per_capita')
exports_df_melted = exports_df.melt(id_vars=['Country Group', 'Country Code'], var_name='Year', value_name='Exports_growth')

# Merge the datasets on 'Country Group', 'Country Code', and 'Year'
merged_df = pd.merge(adjusted_savings_df_melted, gni_per_capita_df_melted, on=['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Year'])
merged_df = pd.merge(merged_df, exports_df_melted, on=['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Year'])

# Drop rows with missing values
merged_df = merged_df.dropna()

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and GNI per capita
correlation_education_gni = merged_df['Education_Expenditure'].corr(merged_df['GNI_per_capita'])

# Calculate the correlation between GNI per capita and exports growth
correlation_gni_exports = merged_df['GNI_per_capita'].corr(merged_df['Exports_growth'])

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and exports growth
correlation_education_exports = merged_df['Education_Expenditure'].corr(merged_df['Exports_growth'])

correlation_education_gni, correlation_gni_exports, correlation_education_exports

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Prepare the data for regression
X = merged_df[['Education_Expenditure', 'GNI_per_capita']]
y = merged_df['Exports_growth']

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients
coefficients = model.coef_
coefficients

import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Plot the relationship between education expenditure and GNI per capita
sns.scatterplot(x='Education_Expenditure', y='GNI_per_capita', data=merged_df)
plt.title('Relationship between Education Expenditure and GNI per Capita')
plt.xlabel('Education Expenditure (percentage of GNI)')
plt.ylabel('GNI per Capita (constant 2015 USD)')
plt.show()

import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Group the data by year and calculate the mean of education expenditure and GNI per capita
time_series_data = merged_df.groupby('Year').agg({'Education_Expenditure': 'mean', 'GNI_per_capita': 'mean'}).reset_index()

# Plot the time series data
sns.lineplot(x='Year', y='Education_Expenditure', data=time_series_data, label='Education Expenditure')
sns.lineplot(x='Year', y='GNI_per_capita', data=time_series_data, label='GNI per Capita')
plt.title('Time Series Analysis of Education Expenditure and GNI per Capita')
plt.xlabel('Year')
plt.ylabel('Value')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
